summary: chunter-cb 对 EIP-8130 连续提交并合并四项修改，其中一项是安全修复：payer 签名哈希此前不含 payer 字段，同一 actor 的签名可被任何授权该 actor 的账户用来付款，现在签名与被扣款账户绑定；另加入 metadata 字段。misilva73 提交 EIP-8037 修改，解决与 EIP-7928 的冲突并把状态 gas 回填路由到 origin。加密 mempool 方向，EIP-8105 和 EIP-8184 征集反馈，GottfriedHerold 撰文批评 LUCID（EIP-8184）。julianma 认为钱包团队缺乏做无 gas 支付的激励。

items.topic: EIP-8130 的 payer 安全修复
items.title: EIP-8130：把 payer 字段纳入 payer 签名哈希
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并。此前 payer 哈希（`AA_PAYER_TYPE` 载荷）不含 `payer`，付款授权只绑定交易体和解析出的 `sender`，没有绑定由哪个账户出钱；而验证（`actor_config(payer, actorId)` 加 PAYER scope）对任何授权了同一 actor 的账户都会通过。现在 payer 的签名与被扣款账户绑定。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: bind payer field into payer signature hash
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged. The payer hash (the `AA_PAYER_TYPE` payload) used to exclude `payer`, so a payer authorization was pinned only to the transaction body and the resolved `sender`, not to which account funds it; validation (`actor_config(payer, actorId)` plus PAYER scope) succeeds for any account that authorizes the same actor. Now the payer's signature is bound to the account being charged.

items.topic: EIP-8037 的状态 gas 计算
items.title: EIP-8037：解决与 EIP-7928 的冲突，并把状态 gas 回填路由到 origin
items.note: （misilva73）提交。一是 `CREATE`/`CREATE2` 的账户创建部分在创建 frame 前无条件扣除，若目标已存在或创建失败，退出时回填，从而避免 EIP-7928 推迟的目标存在性读取；`CALL*` 仍按条件扣费。二是加入 frame 本地的状态 gas 来源记录，回填路由到 origin。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: resolve EIP-7928 conflict and route state gas refills to origin
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted. First, the account creation portion of `CREATE`/`CREATE2` is charged unconditionally before the create frame and refilled on exit if the target already existed or creation failed, avoiding the target existence read that EIP-7928 defers; `CALL*` keeps its conditional charge. Second, a frame-local record of where state gas came from is added, so refills route to the origin.

keywords_en: EIP-8037 state gas refills routed to origin
summary_en: chunter-cb submitted and merged four EIP-8130 changes, one of them a security fix: the payer signature hash did not include the payer field, so a signature from one actor could be used to pay from any account that authorized that actor; now the signature is bound to the account being charged. A metadata field was also added. misilva73 submitted an EIP-8037 change that resolves a conflict with EIP-7928 and routes state gas refills to the origin. On encrypted mempools, EIP-8105 and EIP-8184 asked for feedback, and GottfriedHerold published a criticism of LUCID (EIP-8184). julianma argued wallet teams lack the incentive to build gasless payments.
